# basic-screen-manager

a LOGO/TITLE/GAMEPLAY/ENDING flow

Category: core

Ported from raylib's `examples/core/core_basic_screen_manager.c`.

![basic-screen-manager](../demos/basic-screen-manager.gif)

## Run it

```sh
cd basic-screen-manager && bb run   # from this demo (or jolt run, jolt -M:run)
bb basic-screen-manager             # from the repo root (or jolt -M:basic-screen-manager)
```

## About

raylib [core] example - screen manager (`joltc -M:basic-screen-manager`).

A minimal screen/state machine: LOGO → TITLE → GAMEPLAY → ENDING. It advances on
ENTER, and also auto-advances on a timer so the headless smoke test flows through
every screen. A keyword state drives the background + label.
